Element.name: confidenceValue
Element.Documentation: How confident you (or an algorithm) are of an observation (what you observed (read) in the source), or of a reconstruction. Reflect the uncertainties and ambiguities of the inferred observation (or reconstruction) by choosing one of the values.

Element.name: datePrecision
Element.Documentation: This helps validate that dateStart/dateEnd are filled correctly.

Element.name: dateStart
Element.Documentation: Enter earliest possible date in EDTF format. Rules: 1) For an EXACT date: enter the date in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 2) For a RANGE: enter earliest in dateStart, latest in dateEnd. 3) For "BEFORE X": leave dateStart empty, enter X in dateEnd. 4) For "AFTER Y": enter Y in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 5) EDTF uncertainty markers (?, ~, %) can be used in either field, follow the instructions here: https://knaw.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/PRJ-Brievenportaal/IQB7jUVOq98BR4Oy786Ch8n1AcilMidno3GLLVdmgUaYF-8?e=FBjVTA

Element.name: dateEnd

Element.name: recordStatus
Element.Documentation: To indicate the stage the record is at in terms of completeness. For example, for a Source: all relevant data has been extracted from the source, or if there is still data that could be extracted at a later stage. For an Entity observation: if it is an initial draft, or if all the observation-related data is entered.

item.AppInfo: Use for sources which are not yet analized, no data is extracted
Use for Entities (e.g., Actor) which are created quickly but no data is yet extracted
Use for Sources or Entities for which some data has been extracted, but there are still other pieces of data to be extracted
all relevant data from this Source or Entity has been extracted
